create_cache_torch: create a Cache instance in torch mode to automatically save and load computation results to disk
create_cache_memmap: create a Cache instance in memmap mode to save numpy arrays as memory-mapped files on disk
use_cache_get: use Cache.get to run a computation function and cache its result by keyword arguments
create_memory_cache: create a MemoryCache instance to share cached computation results in memory across multiple feature instances
use_memory_cache_get: use MemoryCache.get to run a computation function and cache its result in memory by arguments
